exposure: patients with a cesarean scar diverticulum undergoing frozen embryo transfer
presence or absence of cesarean scar diverticulum
presence or absence of endometrial cavity fluid
cohort: 1538 patients undergoing embryo transfer, including 215 with a cesarean scar diverticulum and 1323 without
finding: The presence of cesarean section scar diverticulum was associated with reduced odds of clinical pregnancy and live birth after in vitro fertilization.
